hero.title: I build infrastructure that gets out of the way.
hero.description: I design and build platforms that reduce operational complexity and expose clear self-service interfaces — across Kubernetes, runtime systems, delivery pipelines, and developer tooling.

proof.title: Systems measured by what they unlock.
proof.description: The useful output is not infrastructure alone. It is faster delivery, less manual work, lower cost, and teams that can move without waiting on a central operator.

services.title: From unclear constraints to an operable system.
services.description: I work at the boundary between application teams and infrastructure, turning distributed operational knowledge into explicit platform contracts.

items.title: Platform foundations
items.description: Internal platforms and self-service interfaces that remove operational bottlenecks without hiding the underlying system.

items.title: Runtime systems

items.title: Delivery systems
items.description: CI/CD and GitOps workflows designed for repeatable releases, clear rollback paths, and ownership teams can trust.

items.title: Infrastructure automation

work.title: Complex systems, made usable.
work.description: A selection of platform and infrastructure work from previously documented projects.

items.title: Mobile platform consolidation
items.challenge: Fragmented build and test environments across mobile teams.
items.response: Centralized resource allocation and standardized workflows across 20+ Mac Studios and a Kubernetes Android farm.
items.outcome: 35% faster releases and unified delivery processes.

items.title: Pipeline-as-a-Service
items.challenge: Each mobile team maintained a different CI/CD implementation.
items.response: A self-service pipeline platform with shared core logic and controlled project-level adaptation.
items.outcome: Centralized pipeline management and improved developer velocity.

items.title: Internal artifact platform
items.challenge: A costly third-party platform with limited room for integration.
items.response: A unified artifact storage and distribution service with HTTP/gRPC APIs, a web interface, and CI/CD integration.
items.outcome: Lower platform cost and simpler artifact operations.

items.title: Aurora Serverless migration
items.challenge: High database cost and manual capacity planning.
items.response: Automated migration to Aurora Serverless v2 with demand-based capacity management.
items.outcome: 15% cost reduction and no manual capacity planning.

about.title: Engineering across the whole path to production.
about.description: My work spans platform architecture, implementation, delivery, and operations. I am most useful where system boundaries are unclear, operational load is growing, or teams need a dependable path from one-off tooling to a shared platform.

styleguide.title: Corrupt the signal. Preserve the meaning.
styleguide.description: A controlled visual language for technical credibility: hard structure, high contrast, deliberate chromatic errors, and motion that appears only when it carries attention.

principles.title: Signal over noise
principles.description: The message remains readable before any effect is applied.

principles.title: Damage with intent
principles.description: Glitch marks a transition, interaction, or hierarchy — never decoration everywhere.

principles.title: Structure first
principles.description: A strict grid, consistent spacing, and strong type make distortion feel deliberate.

principles.title: Motion earns attention
principles.description: Effects are brief, interruptible, and removed when reduced motion is requested.

footer.note: Built as a system. Broken with intent.
